title: RNA Extraction and Analysis Methods and Chemicals Used in DBY12007 Study
summary: This cluster is centered around the DBY12007 organism, which undergoes the HAP1 process. The RNA extraction and analysis methods used include RNeasy Minikit, Invitrogen superscript III One-Step RT-PCR System, and various spectrophotometric purity assessments by NanoDrop. The Tu et al. study is referenced in the YMC chemical, which has phases High-DO and Low-DO and uses Dissolved oxygen. The GSEA gene_or_protein is used in the Tu et al. study. The Beaucher method_or_tool is used to select primers, specifically Gapdh1/2 primers. The DESeq2, GSEA, and STAR gene_or_proteins are likely involved in the analysis of the RNA data.
